# Cheapflights

> Cheapflights is a travel aggregator platform that compares flight prices, airline tickets, and airfares to help users find and book cheap flights to destinations worldwide.

Cheapflights provides a comprehensive flight search and comparison tool that aggregates prices from multiple airlines and booking partners including Expedia, Spirit Airlines, Frontier, and Kiwi.com. The platform specializes in helping budget-conscious travelers find the best deals on flights to popular domestic and international destinations.
